

== Documented PC state ==

Released uses by 2023, based on the publisher’s identified 2023 edition.<ref name="pc-documented-state">Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, page 131, There'll Be Hell To Pay: grabber-icon amendment.</ref> The current PC illustration retains the original game text and adds the documented grabber icon.
